Checkmarx One

Projects, scans and scan results statistics on Checkmarx One, the cloud service

skills/toil/checkmarx.md

Projects, scans and scan results statistics on Checkmarx One, the cloud service, through its REST API under /api. Every command reads; none changes anything. Verification level: unit.

Supported versions: The oldest Checkmarx One version toil supports hasn’t been established. Checkmarx One is cloud only, so there is no server release to pin. toil calls its REST API under /api with a bearer token exchanged from an API key.

Credential

A Checkmarx One API key, generated once in Checkmarx One. The key is a refresh token: toil exchanges it for a short-lived access token and sends that as Authorization: Bearer <token>. The exchange is a form POST of grant_type=refresh_token, client_id and refresh_token to

https://<region>.iam.checkmarx.net/auth/realms/<tenantName>/protocol/openid-connect/token

The IAM host is the API host with ast. swapped for iam. (eu.ast.checkmarx.net becomes eu.iam.checkmarx.net). client_id is the key’s own azp claim, or ast-app when the key doesn’t carry one. The access token is kept in memory, renewed shortly before it expires, and never written to disk. toil sends the API key only to a host under checkmarx.net over HTTPS, or to the connection’s own host; any other derived host is refused with AUTH, so Checkmarx One cloud is the only deployment that works.

Client credentials aren’t supported. The client_credentials grant needs an OAuth client registered for toil, which the Authentication Bar rules out. Until an API key is set, the call is CONFIG_INVALID naming apiKey and TOIL_CHECKMARX_API_KEY.

Configuration

KeyEnv varRequiredMeaning
baseUrlTOIL_CHECKMARX_BASE_URLyesThe API base, ending in /api, e.g. https://eu.ast.checkmarx.net/api
tenantNameTOIL_CHECKMARX_TENANT_NAMEyesTenant name (the IAM realm), e.g. imagile
apiKeyTOIL_CHECKMARX_API_KEYyesAPI key

There’s no CI fallback variable.

Environment variables (CI, or a one-off shell):

export TOIL_CHECKMARX_BASE_URL=https://eu.ast.checkmarx.net/api
export TOIL_CHECKMARX_TENANT_NAME=imagile
export TOIL_CHECKMARX_API_KEY=<your API key>

Or ~/.toil/config.json:

{
  "version": 2,
  "connections": {
    "cx": { "area": "checkmarx", "baseUrl": "https://eu.ast.checkmarx.net/api", "tenantName": "imagile" }
  },
  "defaults": { "checkmarx": { "connection": "cx" } }
}

The API key never goes in this file; a plaintext one there is refused with CONFIG_INVALID. Run toil connections add cx --area checkmarx (or toil connections login cx for an existing connection) to keep it in the OS credential store, or set TOIL_CHECKMARX_API_KEY.

Commands

  • project list: List all projects. One request for the first 100; when Checkmarx One counts more, meta.warnings says so (CHECKMARX_TRUNCATED, “N projects found; only showing first 100”). data is the bare list of projects.
  • project get: Get a project by ID (--id <uuid>).
  • scan list: List scans, optionally for one project (--project <uuid>). --last <n> sets how many come back (default 100), read as a leading integer, so 5abc is 5; a value with no leading number is INVALID_INPUT. No order is requested, so “last” is whatever order Checkmarx One returns. More than that many gives the same CHECKMARX_TRUNCATED warning.
  • scan get: Get a scan by ID (--id <uuid>).
  • scan stats: Get results statistics for a scan (--id <uuid>): the counts highSeverity, mediumSeverity, lowSeverity, infoSeverity and, when Checkmarx One sends it, severitiesTotalCount, from results/summary.
toil checkmarx project list
toil checkmarx scan list --project abc12345-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --last 5
toil checkmarx scan stats --id abc12345-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1

Settings at a glance

  • baseUrl required

    Checkmarx One API base, ending in /api, e.g. https://eu.ast.checkmarx.net/api

    TOIL_CHECKMARX_BASE_URL

  • tenantName required

    Tenant name, e.g. imagile

    TOIL_CHECKMARX_TENANT_NAME

  • apiKey required secret

    API key

    TOIL_CHECKMARX_API_KEY

Commands at a glance

  • toil checkmarxproject list

    List all projects

    MCP checkmarx_project_list

  • toil checkmarxproject get

    Get a project by ID

    MCP checkmarx_project_get--id <id>

  • toil checkmarxscan list

    List scans

    MCP checkmarx_scan_list--project <id>--last <n>

  • toil checkmarxscan get

    Get a scan by ID

    MCP checkmarx_scan_get--id <id>

  • toil checkmarxscan stats

    Get results statistics for a scan

    MCP checkmarx_scan_stats--id <id>
